steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Standing Preacher Curl
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Rest the back of your upper arms against the preacher bench or an incline bench, with your elbows slightly bent.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Standing Zottman Preacher Curl
steps: Stand behind a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms against the pad and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells with your palms facing down until your arms are extended.
At the bottom, rotate your wrists so your palms face up again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Step up Single Leg Balance With Bicep Curl
steps: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Engage your core and push through your right heel to lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left knee up towards your chest.
At the top of the movement, perform a bicep curl by bending your elbows and bringing the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells back down and simultaneously lower your left foot back to the ground.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, stepping up with your left foot and curling the dumbbells.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Step-up
steps: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the bench or step, straightening your right leg.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench or step, standing fully upright.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Step-up Lunge
steps: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Push through your right heel and step up onto the platform, bringing your left foot up beside it.
Step back down to the floor with your left foot, then your right.
Step your right foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through your front heel to bring your right foot back to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating the lead leg each time.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Step-up Split Squat
steps: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot flat on the step, then reach your left foot back so you are in a split stance with your left foot on the floor.
Lower your body by bending both knees, keeping your right foot flat on the step, until your left knee nears the floor.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing a slight bend in your knees.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze your glutes and push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your torso to lean forward.
Continue lowering the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull Through
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointed outwards.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down into a squat position, keeping your back straight.
Lower the dumbbell down between your legs, keeping your arms straight.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips forward, pulling the dumbbell up and in front of your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then lower the dumbbell back down between your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Supported Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended over your chest and palms facing your feet.
Let the inner ends of the dumbbells touch.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows outward to lower the dumbbells to your chest.
Extend your elbows to press the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback With Stork Stance
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in your right hand, then lift your right foot off the floor so you balance on your left leg.
Bend your standing knee slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your right upper arm up beside your torso, parallel to the floor, with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Keeping your upper arm still, extend your right arm straight back, squeezing your triceps.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your elbow to return the dumbbell to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Twisting Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face towards you at the bottom of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then reverse the movement by pressing the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
As you press the dumbbells up, twist your wrists back to the starting position with palms facing away from you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your upper arms out to the sides to shoulder height, with your elbows bent 90 degrees, forearms parallel to the floor and palms facing down.
Keeping your upper arms still, rotate your forearms up until they are vertical, with the dumbbells above your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearms back to parallel.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Waiter Biceps Curl
steps: Stand up straight and hold a single dumbbell vertically, cupping the underside of the top plate with both palms like a tray.
Keep your upper arms close to your body and your elbows tucked in.
Slowly curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulders, keeping it upright.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell W-press
steps: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells beside your shoulders with your elbows tucked low and close to your ribs, forearms angled out to form a W.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to the W position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms face down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells all the way down with your palms facing down.
At the bottom, rotate your palms back to face forward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Zottman Preacher Curl
steps: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and elbows resting on the pad.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary and your palms facing up.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells with your palms facing down until your arms are extended.
At the bottom, rotate your wrists so your palms face up again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Elbow Dips
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Elbow Lift - Reverse Push-up
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and your elbows bent at your sides with your forearms pointing up.
Press your elbows into the floor to lift your chest and upper back off the ground, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top for a moment, squeezing your upper back muscles.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Elevator
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or cross them in front of your chest.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the waist, lowering your upper body towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Alternating Arm Ups
steps: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inwards and your arms extended down by your sides.
Engage your core and slowly lift one arm up towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Arms Extended
steps: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, with your palms facing down.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, keeping your back straight and your neck in line with your spine.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Hands Behind Head
steps: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it with your hips resting on the ball.
Position your feet against a wall or other stable surface for support.
Cross your arms behind your head, with your hands touching the back of your head.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Knees Off Ground
steps: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Position your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Back Extension With Rotation
steps: Start by lying face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips and legs stable.
Return to the center and repeat the rotation to the other side.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Dip
steps: Sit on the stability ball and place your hands on the ball just behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward and slide your hips off the front of the ball, supporting your weight on your hands with your arms straight and knees bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing back, until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Stand in front of the stability ball, facing away from it.
Place the top of your left foot on the ball behind you and step your right foot forward into a lunge stance, front knee over your ankle.
Lower your hips and press them forward, tucking your pelvis slightly, until you feel a stretch in the front of your left hip.
Hold for the desired time, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Hug
steps: Kneel on the floor in front of a stability ball.
Drape your torso over the ball and wrap your arms around it.
Let your back round over the ball and relax your head and neck.
Hold the stretch for the desired time, then slowly return to kneeling.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Lat Stretch
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up overhead.
Slowly lean to the opposite side, feeling a stretch in your lat muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Lower Back Stretch (pyramid)
steps: Kneel on the floor behind a stability ball.
Lean forward and drape your torso face down over the ball.
Let your arms and head hang down and your back round over the ball into a pyramid shape.
Hold the stretch for the desired time, then slowly return to kneeling.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Lying Side Lat Stretch
steps: Kneel beside a stability ball and lie sideways over it with the ball under your ribs and hip.
Extend your legs and stagger your feet on the floor for balance.
Reach your top arm overhead, letting your side lengthen over the ball.
Hold the stretch for the desired time, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball on The Wall Calf Raise
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball on The Wall Calf Raise (tennis Ball Between Ankles)
steps: Stand with your back to a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball on The Wall Calf Raise (tennis Ball Between Knees)
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball One Leg Prone Lower Body Rotation
steps: Lie face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Engage your glutes and core muscles to stabilize your body.
Slowly lift one leg off the ground, keeping it straight and parallel to the floor.
Rotate your leg outward, away from your body, while keeping your hips and upper body stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball One Legged Diagonal Kick Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on top of the stability ball and your arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
Lift one leg off the ball, keeping the other heel on the ball.
Roll the ball toward your glutes by bending the supporting knee while kicking the free leg diagonally up and across your body.
Straighten the supporting leg to roll the ball back out while you return the free leg, keeping your hips lifted.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Pike Push up
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands on the floor and your shins resting on the stability ball.
Engage your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, rolling the ball towards your hands.
Keep your legs straight and your body in a pike position, forming an inverted V shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your upper body towards the floor, keeping your head in line with your hands.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Prone Leg Raise
steps: Lie face down with your hips on the stability ball, hands on the floor in front of the ball, and toes on the floor.
Engage your core.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them until they are in line with your torso, using your lower back and glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Seated Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend one leg forward with your heel on the floor, toes pointing up and knee straight.
Place your hands on your bent leg's thigh and keep your back flat.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of your straight leg.
Hold for the desired time, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Seated Triceps Stretch
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up above your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arm close to your ear.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Exercise Ball Supine Triceps Extension
steps: Sit on an exercise ball holding a dumbbell, then walk your feet forward until your head, neck and upper back rest on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders, with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Pause for a moment, then extend your elbows to raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Bar French Press on Exercise Ball
steps: Sit on an exercise ball and hold an EZ barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms straight up, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Bar Lying Bent Arms Pullover
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold the EZ barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms above your chest, then bend your elbows to about 90 degrees so the bar sits above your forehead.
Keeping your elbows fixed at about 90 degrees, lower the barbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the arc motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Bar Lying Close Grip Triceps Extension Behind Head
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the ez barbell with a close grip, palms facing up, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Bar Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and hands shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Pull the ez barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the ez barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Bar Seated Close Grip Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet wider than shoulder-width and hold an ez barbell with a close underhand grip on the inner handles.
Lean forward and brace the backs of both upper arms against your inner thighs, arms extended.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary against your thighs.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Bar Standing French Press
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Anti Gravity Press
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding an ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the bar to shoulder level in front of your head, elbows bent.
Press the bar forward and overhead in line with your torso until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the bar back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Close Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit on a preacher curl bench and grip the inner (close) handles of the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands narrower than shoulder width.
Rest your triceps on the pad and fully extend your arms, keeping your back straight.
Slowly curl the barbell towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Close-grip Curl
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell on the inner handles with an underhand grip, hands narrower than shoulder width.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Curl
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Decline Close Grip Face Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Grasp the ez barbell on the inner handles with a close overhand grip.
Extend your arms straight up above your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the barbell towards your face by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then press the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Decline Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and your feet secured.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Incline Triceps Extension
steps: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell jm Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width or closer.
Lower the bar towards your chin and upper chest by bending your elbows and letting them travel forward, keeping your forearms angled.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Reverse Grip Curl
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Curl the barbell upwards while exhaling.
Continue to raise the barbell until it is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause.
Slowly bring the barbell back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the ez barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Rest your upper arms on the pad, allowing your forearms to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Seated Curls
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your arms at your sides and let the bar rest on your thighs.
Keeping your elbows by your sides, exhale and curl the ez barbell upwards towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the ez barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Seated Triceps Extension
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Raise the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez Barbell Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight down towards the floor.
Keeping your upper arms vertical and stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ez-bar Biceps Curl (with Arm Blaster)
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping them stationary throughout the exercise.
Keeping your elbows close to your body, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Ez-bar Close-grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close grip, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Ez-barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Flag
steps: Stand side-on to a sturdy vertical pole and grip it with both hands, the top hand above your head and the bottom hand about shoulder-width below it.
Lock your bottom arm straight and push it into the pole while pulling with your top arm.
Engage your core and lift your feet off the ground, raising your body sideways.
Bring your body to horizontal with your legs straight and together, side-on to the pole.
Hold this position for the desired time, then lower your legs back down to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Flexion Leg Sit up (bent Knee)
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
At the same time, lift your legs off the ground, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Flexion Leg Sit up (straight Arm)
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms straight above your head.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground while simultaneously lifting your legs towards your chest.
Reach your hands towards your toes as you lift your upper body and legs.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms extended straight up over your chest, palms facing each other.
Slowly lower the dumbbells out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor, feeling a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Forward Jump
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Swing your arms back for momentum.
Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Forward Lunge (male)
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping your knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration by Bryl Lim, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Frog Crunch
steps: Lie flat on your back with the soles of your feet pressed together and your knees dropped out to the sides.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Frog Planche
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your knees on the outside of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands until your feet lift off the floor.
Hold the balance for the desired time.
Lower your feet back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Front Lever
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the bar down toward your hips to raise your body up, tucking your knees first if needed.
Extend your hips and legs so your whole body is straight and horizontal, face up.
Hold this position for the desired time.
To release, slowly lower your body back down to the hang.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Front Lever Reps
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your arms straight and your body straight, pull the bar down toward your hips to raise your whole body up to horizontal, face up.
Slowly lower your body back down to the hang under control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Front Plank With Twist
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Engage your core and glutes to maintain a stable position.
Rotate your torso to the right, lifting your right arm and extending it towards the ceiling.
Keep your hips and legs stable as you twist.
Hold for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist on the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Full Maltese
steps: Place your hands on the floor or on parallettes wide of your hips, fingers turned out, and lie face down with your legs together.
Lock your elbows and lean forward so your shoulders move well past your hands.
Press down through your hands to lift your whole body off the floor, keeping it straight and horizontal close to the ground.
Hold this position on straight, wide arms for the desired time.
Lower your body back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Full Planche
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers turned slightly out, and your feet together.
Lock your elbows, push the floor away so your shoulder blades spread apart, and brace your core and glutes.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands until your feet become light, then lift them off the floor.
Keep leaning until your whole body is straight and parallel to the floor, legs together, balancing on your hands.
Hold the position with straight arms for the desired time.
Lower your feet back to the floor under control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Full Planche Push-up
steps: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out slightly.
Lock your elbows, lean your shoulders forward past your hands and lift your feet off the floor into a full planche, body straight and horizontal.
Keeping your feet off the floor, lower your body toward the ground by bending your elbows.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the full planche.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Glute Bridge March
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, lift one foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your foot back to the ground and repeat the movement with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs in a marching motion while maintaining the bridge position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration by Bryl Lim, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Glute Bridge Two Legs on Bench (male)
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with both heels on a bench, knees bent and arms by your sides.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Gorilla Chin
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull your body up towards the bar while drawing your knees up to your chest.
Continue until your chin is above the bar and your knees are at chest height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body and legs back down together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Groin Crunch
steps: Lie flat on your back with the soles of your feet pressed together and your knees falling out to the sides.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Keeping your soles together and knees open, engage your abs and curl your head and shoulders off the ground toward your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Hack Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Stand on the sled machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hack One Leg Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the sled machine to an appropriate weight.
Stand on the sled machine with one foot, keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up on the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Half Knee Bends (male)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body only about halfway down, as if beginning to sit back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Half Sit-up (male)
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hands Bike
steps: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to a comfortable level.
Sit facing the ergometer with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor or footrest.
Grasp the handles with your hands and position your arms at a 90-degree angle.
Start pedaling with your hands, pushing and pulling the handles in a controlled motion.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Hands Clasped Circular Toe Touch (male)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hands Reversed Clasped Circular Toe Touch (male)
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, interlace your fingers, turn your palms away from you and extend your arms overhead.
Keeping your hands clasped and arms straight, bend to one side and circle your torso down toward the toes of that foot.
Continue the circle, sweeping your clasped hands across past the toes of the other foot.
Rise up the opposite side to return your arms overhead.
Repeat the circle in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating directions for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Handstand
steps: Stand facing a wall about a step away from it.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, a hand's length from the wall, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up so your heels rest against the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, lock your arms and push the floor away to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for the desired time.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground one at a time.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Handstand Push-up
steps: Find a wall and face away from it, standing a few feet away.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart and kick your feet up against the wall, coming into a handstand position.
Bend your elbows and lower your head towards the ground, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration by Bryl Lim, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Hanging Leg Hip Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs by flexing your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Continue the movement by curling your pelvis up and bringing your knees toward your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, twisting your torso to the side as you do so.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, twisting your torso in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your straight legs up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Continue by curling your hips up and rolling your pelvis back, bringing your legs toward the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hanging Straight Twisting Leg Hip Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your legs straight.
Engage your core and lift your legs up towards your chest, keeping them straight.
Once your legs are parallel to the ground, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards that side.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, but this time twist your hips to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: High Knee Against Wall
steps: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the wall for support.
Engage your core and lift your right knee up towards your chest, while keeping your left foot on the ground.
Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee up towards your chest and lowering your right foot back down.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, bringing your knees up as high as possible.
Maintain a fast pace and keep your upper body stable throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hyght Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Hyperextension
steps: Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your upper thighs are resting on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Photos: Free Exercise DB, public domain.

name: Hyperextension (on Bench)
steps: Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your hips are resting comfortably on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Slowly lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Impossible Dips
steps: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your forearms rest along the bars.
Pause for a moment, then press through your hands to lift your forearms off the bars and straighten your arms without kicking.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Incline Leg Hip Raise (leg Straight)
steps: Lie on an incline bench with your head at the high end, your back flat against the bench and your legs extended straight.
Grip the top of the bench behind your head for support.
Engaging your abs, lift your straight legs off the bench until they point toward the ceiling.
Continue by curling your hips off the bench, bringing your legs toward your head.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Incline Push-up (on Box)
steps: Place your hands on the edge of a box or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Incline Scapula Push up
steps: Place your hands on a bench or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back, hip-width apart, so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Keeping your elbows locked, let your chest sink toward the bench by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Push through your palms to spread your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Incline Twisting Sit-up
steps: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward.
As you curl up, twist your torso to one side, bringing your elbow towards the opposite knee.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your torso to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Inverse Leg Curl (bench Support)
steps: Kneel on the end of a bench with your ankles secured under a pad or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, with your hands in front of your chest.
Keeping your hips extended, slowly lower your torso forward by straightening at the knees, resisting with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Curl your body back up to the starting position by contracting your hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Inverse Leg Curl (on Pull-up Cable Machine)
steps: Set the thigh pads of a lat pulldown station low and kneel on the seat facing away from the machine, hooking your ankles under the pads.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, with your hands in front of your chest.
Slowly lower your body forward toward the floor, resisting with your hamstrings and keeping your hips extended.
Lower as far as you can control, then pull yourself back up to the starting position with your hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Inverted Row Bent Knees
steps: Set up a bar at waist height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees to about 90 degrees with your feet flat on the floor, keeping your body straight from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Inverted Row on Bench
steps: Set up a bench at a height that allows your body to hang freely underneath it.
Lie face up on the ground with your head towards the bench.
Reach up and grab the bench with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your arms are fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest up towards the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest with your elbows bent and out to the sides.
Press your palms together as hard as you can, squeezing your chest muscles.
Hold this position for a few seconds.
Release the squeeze and relax.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Jack Burpee
steps: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back, landing in a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, lowering your chest to the ground and then pushing back up.
Jump your feet forward, landing in a squat position.
Stand up and perform a jumping jack, jumping your feet out wide as you swing your arms overhead, then jumping them back together.
Land softly and immediately lower back into the squat position to begin the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Jack Jump (male)
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Jump Rope
steps: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again.
Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump explosively off the ground, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your arms forward for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at arm's length with your palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight, so the kettlebells hang just above your knees.
Explosively extend your hips and knees and pull one kettlebell up close to your body, keeping the other one hanging.
Rotate your hand around the handle and catch the kettlebell in the rack position, resting on the outside of your forearm with your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Lower the kettlebell back to the hang position under control.
Clean the other kettlebell the same way, alternating arms each repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Press on Floor
steps: Start by lying on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand, with your palms facing towards your feet and your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower one kettlebell down towards your shoulder while keeping the other kettlebell extended straight up.
Press the lowered kettlebell back up to the starting position while simultaneously lowering the other kettlebell down towards your shoulder.
Continue alternating the press motion with each kettlebell for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Renegade Row
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands gripping the kettlebells and your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull one kettlebell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Bent Press
steps: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position in your right hand, with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width and toes turned slightly to the left.
Press your right elbow against your side so your forearm stays vertical under the kettlebell.
Shift your hips to the right and lean your torso to the left and forward, sliding your left hand down the inside of your left leg while your right arm stays vertical.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell as you continue lowering your torso away and under it until your right arm is fully locked out.
With the arm locked, stand back up so the kettlebell is held overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back to the rack position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms up Clean From The Hang Position
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Allow the kettlebell to hang down between your legs, with your arm fully extended.
In one fluid motion, explosively extend your hips and knees while pulling the kettlebell up towards your shoulder.
As the kettlebell rises, crush the handle hard and keep your wrist straight so the bell flips bottom-up.
Catch the kettlebell upside down in front of your shoulder, forearm vertical, palm facing in and elbow tucked, holding it balanced.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Extended Range One Arm Press on Floor
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand at your chest, with your upper arm on the floor and your forearm vertical.
Press the kettlebell straight up towards the ceiling until your elbow is locked and your wrist is straight.
At the top, reach the kettlebell further toward the ceiling by lifting your shoulder blade off the floor.
Let your shoulder blade settle back to the floor, then slowly lower the kettlebell until your elbow touches the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Front Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Clean the kettlebell(s) to the rack position, resting on the outside of your forearms with your elbows tucked close to your body.
Engage your core and keep your torso upright as you lower your hips down and back, as if sitting into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Lunge Pass Through
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, pass the kettlebell under your right thigh and transfer it to your left hand.
Push off with your right foot to return to the starting position, while simultaneously passing the kettlebell back to your right hand.
Repeat the lunge on the opposite side, passing the kettlebell under your left thigh.
Continue alternating lunges and passing the kettlebell between hands for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Pirate Supper Legs
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise the kettlebell up to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Extend your arm fully overhead, straightening your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell back down to shoulder height, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Seated Two Arm Military Press
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the kettlebells overhead by extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, pushing your butt back.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your arms straight and maintaining a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, using the momentum generated by your hips.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down between your legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Kick Out Sit
steps: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips, then lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Lift your left hand and rotate your body to the left, kicking your right leg through under your body and out to the left side.
Extend your right leg fully, supporting yourself on your right hand and left foot with your hips low.
Pull the leg back under your body and return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, kicking your left leg through and lifting your right hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Knee Touch Crunch
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the fronts of your thighs.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and slide your hands up your thighs until your fingertips touch your knees.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
steps: Kneel on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your toes pointing back.
Extend your arms overhead and interlace your fingers.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean to the right side, feeling a stretch in your left lat muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the stretch on the left side, leaning to the left and feeling a stretch in your right lat muscle.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Kneeling Plank Tap Shoulder (male)
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your hands forward and keep your knees on the floor so your body forms a straight line from your knees to your head.
Keeping your core engaged and your hips stable, lift one hand off the ground and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the ground and repeat with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Kneeling Push-up (male)
steps: Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your hands forward and keep your knees on the floor so your body forms a straight line from your knees to your head.
