Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Reverse Hyper Extension (on Stability Ball)
steps: Lie face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for stability.
Engaging your glutes and hamstrings, lift your legs up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Reverse Hyper on Flat Bench
steps: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging off the bench.
Hold onto the bench for stability.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Reverse Plank With Leg Lift
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your hands resting on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet.
Press through your hands and lift your hips off the ground, coming into a reverse plank position.
Engage your core and lift one leg off the ground, extending it straight up towards the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Rocking Frog Stretch
steps: Kneel on the floor and slide your knees out as wide as is comfortable, with your feet in line with your knees and your toes pointing out.
Lower onto your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders.
Slowly rock your hips back toward your heels until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs.
Pause for a moment, then rock your hips forward to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Rocky Pull-up Pulldown
steps: Stand in front of a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Roller Back Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor with the roller behind you, perpendicular to your body, and your knees bent with your feet flat.
Lie back so the roller is under your mid-back, with your hands behind your head.
Lift your hips slightly off the floor.
Push with your legs to roll your body so the roller moves from your mid-back up to your upper back.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll back to your mid-back.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Roller Body Saw
steps: Start in a forearm plank with your forearms on the floor and your shins resting on the roller.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Push your body backward by reaching your arms forward from the shoulders, letting your legs roll on the roller while keeping your hips level.
Pull your body forward by bringing your elbows back under your shoulders.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Roller Hip Lat Stretch
steps: Start by kneeling on the ground with the roller positioned under your hips.
Place your hands on the roller for support.
Slowly roll the roller forward, extending your hips and stretching your glutes.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Roller Hip Stretch
steps: Sit on the roller with it under your right glute and place your hands on the floor behind you for support.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, keeping your left foot flat on the floor.
Lean slightly toward your right side to put your weight on the right glute.
Slowly roll back and forth over the glute, pausing on any tight spots.
Continue for the desired time, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Roller Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, palms down.
Squeeze a roller between your knees and lift your legs so your thighs are vertical and your knees are bent at 90 degrees.
Engaging your abs, curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest while holding the roller in place.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Roller Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor
steps: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean forward slightly and roll the roller away from your body, extending your arms straight in front of you.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the roller back towards your body, bending your arms and bringing the roller back to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Roller Seated Single Leg Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor
steps: Sit on the floor with your left leg extended and your right knee bent, right foot flat on the floor.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, resting it on your thighs with your arms straight.
Sit up tall and engage your core.
Raise the roller up past shoulder level and overhead, keeping your arms straight.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades down and back without bending your arms.
Slowly lower the roller back down to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Roller Side Lat Stretch
steps: Kneel on the floor and place a roller in front of you, slightly to your right.
Rest your right forearm on the roller with your thumb up, and place your left hand on the floor for support.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and roll the roller forward and out to the right, sinking your chest toward the floor.
Pause for a few seconds in the stretch along your right side, then roll the roller back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Run
steps: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Keep your upper body relaxed and lean slightly forward from the ankles.
Begin running forward with a natural stride, landing lightly on your midfoot under your hips.
Swing your arms in a relaxed motion with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Maintain a steady pace for the desired time or distance.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Run (equipment)
steps: Step onto the treadmill and start the belt at a walking pace.
Set the speed and incline you want to run at.
Run with a natural stride, landing lightly under your hips and keeping your arms relaxed.
Stay near the middle of the belt with your posture upright.
Run for the desired time or distance, then slow to a walk before stopping the belt.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Scapula Dips
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with your arms straight and your elbows locked.
Keeping your elbows straight, let your shoulders rise toward your ears so your body sinks.
Push your shoulders down away from your ears to lift your body back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Scapula Push-up
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms locked, and your body in a straight line.
Keeping your elbows straight, let your chest sink toward the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Seated Glute Stretch
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right ankle over your left thigh.
Place your right hand on the ground behind you for support.
With your left hand, gently press down on your right knee to deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Switch sides and repeat.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Seated Leg Raise
steps: Sit on a flat bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, slowly raise them up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
steps: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet flat on the ground, slightly wider than hip-width.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Slowly round your spine forward, letting your chest drop toward your thighs and your hands slide toward the floor.
Let your head hang and hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling it in your lower back.
Slowly roll back up to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Seated Side Crunch (wall)
steps: Sit on the floor with your back against a wall and your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lean to one side, bringing your elbow towards your hip.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Seated Wide Angle Pose Sequence
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in a wide angle.
Flex your feet and engage your quadriceps.
Place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Keeping your back straight, lean forward from your hips.
Continue leaning forward until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
Slowly release the stretch and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
steps: Kneel on a pad facing a bench or box, with your ankles anchored under a fixed object or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, with your hands ready over the bench.
Keeping your hips extended, slowly lower your torso forward, resisting with your hamstrings and using your hands on the bench to control the descent.
Pause just above the bench.
Push with your hands as little as needed while you curl back up to the starting position with your hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl (on Floor)
steps: Kneel on a pad on the floor with your ankles anchored under a fixed object or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, with your hands in front of your chest.
Keeping your hips extended, slowly lower your torso toward the floor, resisting with your hamstrings.
When you can no longer control the descent, catch yourself with your hands on the floor.
Push off the floor with your hands just enough to help start the movement, then curl back up to the starting position with your hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Semi Squat Jump (male)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Short Stride Run
steps: Find an open space or a treadmill to perform the exercise.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Start jogging in place, lifting your knees high and pumping your arms.
After a few seconds, start taking short strides forward, maintaining a quick pace.
Continue running with short strides for the desired duration or distance.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Shoulder Grip Pull-up
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip, palms facing away from you.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Shoulder Tap
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right hand off the ground, reaching across to tap your left shoulder.
Place your right hand back on the ground and repeat with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps while keeping your hips and torso stable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Shoulder Tap Push-up
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you push back up, lift your right hand off the ground and tap your left shoulder.
Return your right hand to the ground and repeat the push-up, this time lifting your left hand and tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps with each push-up repetition.
Maintain a stable core and avoid excessive hip rotation throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration by Bryl Lim, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Side Bridge Hip Abduction
steps: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Side Hip (on Parallel Bars)
steps: Stand between two parallel bars with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the bars and lift your body off the ground, supporting your weight on straight arms with your legs hanging.
Engage your abs and raise your knees up and toward one side, twisting your hips so your knees travel toward one shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat toward the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Side Hip Abduction
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Side Lying Hip Adduction (male)
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your bottom arm under your head for support.
Bend your top leg and cross it over the bottom leg, planting that foot flat on the floor in front of your bottom knee.
Engage your adductors and lift your straight bottom leg toward the ceiling as high as you can without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT. Illustration: Exercise data by RepDB (repdb.co).

name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
steps: Lie on your side next to a bench and rest the inside of your top foot or knee on the bench.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder, with your bottom leg on the floor.
Press your top leg down into the bench to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet.
Lift your bottom leg up to meet the underside of the bench.
Slowly lower your bottom leg and hips back toward the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Side Push Neck Stretch
steps: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
Repeat the stretch 2-3 times on each side.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Side Push-up
steps: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Wrap your bottom arm across your waist and place your top hand on the floor in front of your chest, fingers pointing toward your head.
Press through your top hand to straighten that arm, lifting your upper body off the floor while your hips and legs stay down.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Side Wrist Pull Stretch
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Extend your right arm out to the side, parallel to the ground, with your palm facing down.
With your left hand, grab your right hand and gently pull it towards your body, feeling a stretch in your right forearm.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Side-to-side Toe Touch (male)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Return to the starting position and then bend at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Repeat the side-to-side bending motion for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Single Leg Bridge With Outstretched Leg
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Single Leg Calf Raise (on a Dumbbell)
steps: Place a dumbbell (a hex dumbbell lying flat works best) on the floor next to a wall or sturdy support.
Stand with the ball of one foot on the dumbbell and your heel hanging lower, holding the support with one hand.
Lift your other foot off the ground and let your heel drop as low as possible.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down below the dumbbell.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Single Leg Platform Slide
steps: Start by standing with one foot on a platform or slide board.
Bend your knee slightly and slide the foot on the platform backward, extending your leg.
Keep your core engaged and maintain a straight posture throughout the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by sliding your foot back to the initial position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Single Leg Squat (pistol) Male
steps: Stand on your left leg with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and extend the leg straight out in front of you.
Slowly lower your body by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back, keeping your right leg straight and off the floor.
Keep your chest up and your left heel down as you lower yourself.
Descend until your hamstring rests on your calf at the bottom of the squat.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold onto a stable object with one hand for balance.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Push your knees forward and lower your body while leaning your torso back, keeping your hips extended so your body stays in a straight line from knees to head.
Continue lowering until your knees are well forward and you feel a deep stretch in your quads, or as far as you can control.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT. Illustration by Bryl Lim, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Sit-up With Arms on Chest
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Skater Hops
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT. Illustration by Bryl Lim, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Ski Ergometer
steps: Stand facing the SkiErg with your feet hip-width apart and take a handle in each hand.
Reach your arms overhead with a slight bend in your elbows.
Drive the handles down by pulling with your lats and pressing with your triceps, hinging at the hips and bending your knees slightly.
Finish with the handles past your hips and your torso leaning forward.
Let the handles rise as you return to standing tall with your arms overhead.
Continue for the desired time or distance.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Ski Step
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your back straight.
Jump to the right, landing on your right foot while swinging your left leg behind your right leg.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot while swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
Continue alternating jumps from side to side, mimicking a skiing motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Skin The Cat
steps: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled 45 Degrees One Leg Press
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footplate.
Place one foot on the footplate and extend your leg, pushing the sled away from you.
Slowly bend your knee and lower the sled back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled 45° Calf Press
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward.
Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled 45° Leg Press
steps: Adjust the seat and footplate of the sled machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Continue pushing until your legs are almost fully extended, but without locking your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the footplate back towards your body by bending your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled 45° Leg Wide Press
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the foot platform.
Position your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push against the foot platform to extend your legs and straighten your knees.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bend your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled Calf Press on Leg Press
steps: Sit in the leg press machine and place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the sled, heels hanging off.
Extend your knees and release the safety handles.
Keeping your knees straight and fixed, push the sled away by pointing your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels to stretch your calves.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Sled Closer Hack Squat
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself with your back against the pad.
Place your feet close together on the platform, hip-width apart or narrower, with your toes pointing forward.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for stability.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your feet to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Sled Forward Angled Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself on the machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the machine for support.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels as high as possible, pushing against the resistance of the sled.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled Hack Squat
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable position for your height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Hold onto the handles or bars for stability.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled Lying Calf Press
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled Lying Squat
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Lie on your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly angled outwards.
Grip the handles of the sled machine for stability.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push through your heels and extend your legs to lift the sled.
Lower the sled back down by bending your knees and hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Sled One Leg Calf Press on Leg Press
steps: Sit on the leg press machine with your back against the backrest.
Place the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the sled with your heel hanging off, and rest the other foot on the floor or the frame.
Press the sled up and release the safety catches, keeping your working knee straight with a slight bend.
Let your heel drop toward you by flexing your ankle until you feel a stretch in your calf.
Push the sled away by extending your ankle as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled back to the stretched position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Sledge Hammer
steps: Stand facing a large tire about an arm's length away with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the sledge hammer with one hand near the end of the handle and the other near the head.
Swing the hammer up and back over one shoulder, keeping your top hand near the head.
Bring the hammer down onto the tire, sliding your top hand down the handle to meet your bottom hand and bending your hips and knees as you strike.
Control the rebound and switch your hand positions to swing over the other shoulder on the next strike.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Back Shrug
steps: Set the Smith bar at about mid-thigh height and stand with your back to it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach behind you and grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar by rotating it, and hold it with straight arms behind your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Behind Neck Press
steps: Place an upright bench under the Smith machine so the bar travels just behind your head, and set the bar at about head height.
Sit with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, wider than shoulder-width apart.
Press the bar up slightly and rotate it to unhook it from the rack.
Lower the bar under control behind your head to about ear level, keeping your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Press the bar up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down behind your head.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Bench Press
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar touches your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Bent Knee Good Morning
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to raise your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Bent Over Row
steps: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Chair Squat
steps: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and step under it, resting it across your upper back and gripping it overhand.
Unhook the bar by rotating it.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, about a foot in front of the bar.
Keep your chest up and sit back and down as if into a chair, leaning back into the bar with your shins close to vertical.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Close-grip Bench Press
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Deadlift
steps: Set the Smith bar so it rests at about mid-shin height.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the bar over your midfoot.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees, keeping your back straight and chest up, and grip the bar with an overhand grip just outside your legs.
Rotate the bar to unhook it, then stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body.
Stand up straight, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the bar back to mid-shin by hinging at the hips and bending your knees, keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Decline Bench Press
steps: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Decline Reverse-grip Press
steps: Adjust the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Front Squat (clean Grip)
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at upper-chest height and step under it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders against your collarbone and take a clean grip with your fingertips under the bar just outside your shoulders.
Drive your elbows high and forward, then stand up and rotate the bar to unhook it.
Keeping your torso upright and elbows high, squat down by bending your knees and hips, letting your knees travel forward.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Full Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at about shoulder height.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out, then stand up and rotate the bar to unhook it.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by bending your knees and hips.
Lower your body as deep as your mobility allows, hips well below your knees, keeping your back neutral.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Hack Squat
steps: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and step under it, resting it across your upper traps.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, about a foot in front of the bar, so you lean back into it.
Unhook the bar by rotating it.
Bend your knees and let them travel forward as you lower your body, keeping your torso upright against the bar.
Continue descending until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your feet to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Hip Raise
steps: Set a bench parallel to the Smith machine and the bar at about hip height when you sit on the floor.
Sit on the floor with your upper back against the bench and the bar across your hip crease.
Place your feet flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, and grip the bar on either side of your hips.
Unhook the bar, then push through your heels to drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Incline Bench Press
steps: Adjust the bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit on the bench with your back flat against the pad and feet firmly on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your upper chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Incline Reverse-grip Press
steps: Set an incline bench under the Smith machine so the bar lowers to your upper chest.
Lie back on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar by rotating it and lower it slowly towards your upper chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar is just above your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Leg Press
steps: Set the Smith bar and safeties low enough that you can reach the bar with your feet when lying on the floor beneath it.
Lie on your back under the bar and place your feet on it, shoulder-width apart, with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Press the bar up slightly and rotate it to unhook it.
Bend your knees to lower the bar towards you until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press the bar back up by extending your legs, without locking your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Low Bar Squat
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at about mid-chest height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and set it low on your rear delts, just below the spine of your shoulder blades rather than on your traps.
Grip the bar with your elbows pulled back to hold it in place.
Stand up to lift the bar, rotate it to unhook it, and brace your core.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, letting your torso lean further forward than in a high-bar squat.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Drive through your feet to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Machine Bicep Curl
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to be at waist level.
Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the bar up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Machine Decline Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Adjust the bench on the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Machine Incline Tricep Extension
steps: Adjust the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest.
Lower the bar slowly towards your forehead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Decline Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Set a decline bench under the Smith machine.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and lower it slowly towards your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Narrow Row
steps: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with your back straight and grip the bar with an overhand grip, narrower than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar by rotating it, letting it hang at arm's length.
Row the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith One Arm Row
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to waist level.
Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with one hand using an overhand grip, with your palm facing down.
Keep your elbow close to your body and pull the bar towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith One Leg Floor Calf Raise
steps: Set the Smith machine bar at shoulder height, step under it and rest it across your upper back, gripping it with an overhand grip.
Unhook the bar and stand on one foot flat on the floor, lifting the other foot behind your working ankle.
Raise your heel as high as possible by extending your ankle, keeping your knee straight.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your heel back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Rear Delt Row
steps: Set the Smith bar at about knee height and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor and grip the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Unhook the bar by rotating it, letting it hang at arm's length.
Row the bar to your upper chest with your elbows flared out to the sides, squeezing your rear delts.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Reverse Calf Raises
steps: Place a step under the Smith machine and set the bar just below shoulder height.
Step under the bar, rest it across your upper back, grip it overhand and unhook it by rotating it.
Stand with your heels on the edge of the step and the front of your feet hanging off, toes pointing forward.
Let the front of your feet drop below the step as far as is comfortable.
Raise your toes toward your shins as high as possible, keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your toes back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
steps: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Reverse-grip Press
steps: Place a flat bench under the Smith machine so the bar sits directly above your lower chest when you lie down.
Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor and grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar by rotating it and hold it at arm's length.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Pause briefly, then press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Seated One Leg Calf Raise
steps: Place a bench under the Smith machine with a block or weight plate in front of it, and sit on the bench.
Place the ball of one foot on the block with your heel hanging off, and rest the other foot on the floor.
Lower the bar onto your working thigh just above the knee, using a pad if needed, and unhook it while holding it with your hands.
Lower your heel as far as possible to stretch your calf.
Raise your heel as high as possible by extending your ankle.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Seated Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat height so that the handles are at shoulder level.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and lift them off the supports, extending your arms fully.
Lower the handles down to shoulder level, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the handles up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Seated Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench in front of a Smith machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Shrug
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Sprint Lunge
steps: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height, step under it and rest it across your upper traps with an overhand grip.
Unhook the bar by rotating it, with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Lower your back knee toward the floor until your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Drive up through your front foot and bring your rear knee forward and up to hip height in a sprint position.
Step the same leg back into the lunge to begin the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Squat
steps: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
Keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Standing Back Wrist Curl
steps: Set the Smith bar at about mid-thigh height and stand with your back to it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach behind you and grasp the bar with your palms facing back, hands shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar by rotating it and hold it with straight arms behind your thighs.
Let your wrists drop so the bar lowers slightly.
Curl your wrists up, raising the bar behind you as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Standing Behind Head Military Press
steps: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Position the bar behind your head, resting on your upper traps.
Keep your core engaged and your chest lifted throughout the exercise.
Press the bar overhead by extending your arms, fully straightening them.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Standing Leg Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Standing Military Press
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, with your palms facing forward.
Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Sumo Squat
steps: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Toe Raise
steps: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to comfortably stand with your feet flat on the ground.
Position yourself under the bar with your shoulders directly below it and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform or weight plates, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the smith machine.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the barbell up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Smith Wide Grip Bench Press
steps: Adjust the bench to a comfortable position on the smith machine.
Lie down on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, about one and a half times shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Smith Wide Grip Decline Bench Press
steps: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, about one and a half times shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows pointed outwards.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Sphinx
steps: Lie face down on the ground with your forearms flat on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and lift your chest off the ground, keeping your forearms and toes on the floor.
Hold this position for a few seconds, making sure to keep your neck in a neutral position.
Slowly lower your chest back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Spider Crawl Push up
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor while bringing your right knee out to the side toward your right elbow.
At the bottom, your knee should be at or near your elbow, foot off the floor.
Push back up to the top while returning your right foot to the start.
Repeat with your left knee toward your left elbow.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Spine Stretch
steps: Sit tall on the ground with your legs extended slightly wider than hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Reach your arms forward at shoulder height.
Starting from your head, round your spine forward one vertebra at a time, reaching toward your feet.
Hold the stretch for a moment, then restack your spine one vertebra at a time to sit tall.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Spine Twist
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the left side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Squat on Bosu Ball
steps: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side up.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position yourself on top of the bosu ball.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your heels.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Squat to Overhead Reach
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, extend your arms overhead, reaching towards the ceiling.
Return to the starting position by lowering your arms and bending your knees to squat down again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Squat to Overhead Reach With Twist
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, raise your arms overhead and twist your torso to one side.
Return to the starting position and repeat the squat, this time twisting your torso to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides with each squat repetition.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Stability Ball Crunch (full Range Hands Behind Head)
steps: Sit on the stability ball, then walk your feet forward until your lower back rests on the ball, with your feet flat and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Let your upper back extend back over the ball until you feel a stretch in your abs.
Engaging your abs, curl your upper body up and forward as far as you can.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back over the ball.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Stalder Press
steps: Sit on the floor in a wide straddle with your legs straight and your hands on the floor between your legs, close to your hips.
Lock your elbows and lean your shoulders forward over your hands.
Press down through your hands to lift your hips and legs off the floor, keeping the legs straight and straddled.
Continue lifting your hips up over your hands until they are stacked over your shoulders, then bring your legs up into a handstand.
Lower back down the same way under control to the straddle sit.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Standing Archer
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, parallel to the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
As you rotate, extend your right arm forward and your left arm back, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring.
Hold the position for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the motion, this time rotating your torso to the left and extending your left arm forward and your right arm back.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Standing Behind Neck Press
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell behind your neck with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms, fully extending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Standing Calf Raise (on a Staircase)
steps: Stand on the edge of a step or a sturdy platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold onto a railing or wall for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Standing Calves
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, standing on your toes.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Standing Calves Calf Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel flat on the ground.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight.
You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other leg.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Standing Hamstring And Calf Stretch With Strap
steps: Stand upright and loop a strap around the ball of one foot, holding the ends with both hands.
Step that foot forward a short distance and rest it on its heel with your toes pointing up, keeping the leg straight.
Pull the strap toward you to draw your toes back.
Keeping your back flat, hinge forward from your hips with a slight bend in your back knee until you feel a stretch in your hamstring and calf.
Hold for the desired time, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Standing Single Leg Curl
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot off the ground, bending your knee.
Slowly curl your right heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstring.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your right foot back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Standing Wheel Rollerout
steps: Start by standing tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and the wheel roller in front of you.
Bend at your waist and slowly roll the wheel forward, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until you feel a stretch in your abs and your body is extended as far as possible.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your body, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Stationary Bike Run v. 3
steps: Adjust the seat height and position to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance as desired.
Engage your core muscles to maintain stability and proper posture.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your workout.
Gradually decrease the resistance and slow down before coming to a complete stop.
Stretch your legs and cool down after the workout.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Stationary Bike Walk
steps: Adjust the seat height and position on the stationary bike to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at an easy, walking-like pace, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance level if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration, then gradually reduce your pace and resistance to cool down.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Straddle Maltese
steps: Start in a straight-arm support on a pair of rings, with your arms locked by your sides.
Spread your legs wide apart into a straddle.
Turn the rings out, lean forward and slowly widen your straight arms to the sides as you lower your body toward horizontal.
Hold with your body horizontal near ring height, arms straight and wide, for the desired time.
Bring your arms back in and return to support.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Straddle Planche
steps: Place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out slightly, with your feet spread wide behind you.
Lock your elbows and push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands until your feet lift off the floor, keeping your legs straight and straddled.
Hold your body horizontal on straight arms for the desired time.
Lower your feet back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Straight Leg Outer Hip Abductor
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your core and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Superman Push-up
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your body straight.
Push up explosively so your hands and feet leave the floor.
While in the air, briefly extend your arms straight out in front of you and your legs straight behind you.
Bring your hands back under your shoulders and land softly with your elbows bent, lowering straight into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT. Original illustration made for Hold.

name: Suspended Abdominal Fallout
steps: Attach a suspension trainer to a high anchor point and adjust the straps to about mid-length.
Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the handles with your arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
Lean forward onto the balls of your feet, keeping your body straight from head to heels and your core engaged.
Keeping your arms straight and hips extended, let your arms rise overhead as your body falls forward.
Lower as far as you can while keeping your body straight and maintaining tension in your abs.
Pull the handles back down in front of you with your abs and lats to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
photo_note: Instructions adapted for Hold from exercises-dataset, © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, MIT.

name: Swimmer Kicks v. 2 (male)
steps: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core and lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs back down to the starting position.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Swing 360
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your torso for the desired number of repetitions.
Remember to breathe throughout the exercise.
photo_note: Instructions © 2026 Hasan Emir Yıldırım, exercises-dataset, MIT.

name: Three Bench Dip
steps: Place two benches parallel to each other, about shoulder-width apart, with a third bench in front of them.
